attr.title: PokeDaisy
attr.desc: A Game Boy Advance player for Pokemon games with PokeDaisy's companion beside the game: party, bag, region map, a spoiler free guide, the Pokedex, battle matchups and the trainer card, all read from the running game. Based on PokeDaisy by Lidor Itzhari.
attr.inst: Put your .gba games in /roms/gba. FireRed, LeafGreen and Emerald (English) also get the companion; every other GBA game plays without it.
